title: Homemade Pepperoni Pizza
description: Simple yeast dough topped with classic marinara and pepperoni.

steps.1: Preheat oven to 475°F with a pizza stone or baking sheet inside.
steps.2: Roll out dough on a floured surface to a 12-inch circle.
steps.3: Spread sauce over dough, followed by cheese and pepperoni.
steps.4: Bake until the crust is charred and cheese is bubbly. ?timer-10:00?
